story_type: basket hoist from a 344-foot fishing vessel underway
hook: Chest pains on a 344-foot ship, 30 miles out.
narration: Thirty miles off Crescent City, California, a fisherman on a three hundred and forty-four foot fishing vessel had chest pains.
A Coast Guard Dolphin crew from Air Station North Bend, Oregon, came in over the Alaska Ocean.
The flight mechanic lowered the rescue basket past the rail and down to the deck while the ship kept moving.
A big ship's deck is full of masts, cranes and wires, so the crew picks an open spot and keeps the cable clear of anything that could snag it.
Then the basket swung up off the deck with him inside.
At the door, the crew pulled him in.
outcome: The Dolphin crew flew the thirty-three-year-old to waiting paramedics at the Crescent City airport.

location_card.place: 30 miles west of Crescent City, Calif.

title: Chest pains on a 344-foot ship
